_meta.note: Rebellion flashback lab techs + Ending 2 RT office lines. Lines hint, never state, that the lab made the Kilumen. No young Vane.

lab_techs.name: Intake Clerk Mavis
intro:
Lanyard, please. No pass, no entry.
The stock logs must stay clean.
defeat:
Fine. Sign in. Batch 9 is
through the left door. Don't look.

lab_techs.name: Doorman Tech Orrin
intro:
Nobody walks out with lab stock.
Not tonight. Not ever.
defeat:
They sang at the glass last week.
I told myself it was the pumps.

lab_techs.name: Medic Tech Ilsa
intro:
Retention fell to 40 percent.
I can't lose more of the batch.
defeat:
Every scar here has a file number.
I wrote most of them myself.

lab_techs.name: Dosing Tech Brannick
intro:
Hold still. This is routine.
Well. A procedure. Hold still.
defeat:
They flinch when I enter now.
Is that in the data? It should be.

lab_techs.name: Control Tech Wenna
intro:
Panel says yield is up three
points. So why are they crying?
defeat:
Shut it all down, then. I'll
say the lights failed. Go.

lab_techs.name: Override Tech Stellan
intro:
The Guardian feeds the lines.
No spark, no lab. No lab, no us.
defeat:
Ondravel never asked to be
a battery. I know. I know.

lab_techs.name: Tank Tech Dorrit
intro:
Tank 12 is near term. If you
break the seal, we lose the run.
defeat:
Go on. Let them see the sky.
They were never ours to keep.

lab_techs.name: Tagging Tech Pell
intro:
Specimen 4-B. Specimen 4-C.
Names make it harder. So: none.
defeat:
One of them licked my glove.
I logged it as 'contact event.'

lab_techs.name: Archive Tech Quill
intro:
The early stock didn't hold
shape. We keep them for study.
defeat:
Don't open the back shelf.
Please. Not for my sake. Theirs.

lab_techs.name: Growth Tech Sabine
intro:
Growth rate is the good news.
The research is the good news.
defeat:
They grow fast because we
make them. I said it. Satisfied?

lab_techs.name: Vat Tech Hollis
intro:
Vat 7 is my best yield yet.
You won't spoil my best batch.
defeat:
The vat light went gold just now.
Like it knew. That's not possible.

lab_techs.name: Mixing Tech Aldo
intro:
Formula's mine. Ondravel's
spark, river water, and time.
defeat:
Without the river they'd be
nothing. We took that too.

lab_techs.name: Core Tech Renske
intro:
The crystal draws, we harvest.
It's science. It's just science.
defeat:
He's awake in there, {player}.
He's been awake the whole time.

lab_techs.name: Head Observer Calder
intro:
From up here they're just
numbers. That's why I stay up here.
defeat:
Take the key. Free him.
I'll put it down as a loss.

pages:
{player}! Sit, sit. Let me look
at those scrapes. Hold still.

There. Good as new. You and the
team held the line out there.

The field team's back, all of
them. Mud to the knees. Laughing.

River's coming back slow. A
trickle a day. Slow is still back.

Go rest. That's an order from
your mentor. A kind one.

The lantern burned brighter
last night. I think he knew.

The field team came home.
I walked out to meet them.

That blank stone? Didn't need
it. Best kind of stone to lose.

Sit a while, {player}. The
river's finding its way. No rush.

RITA here. Ondravel released.
Operations adjusted. Noted.

Fitted crystals still work.
The asset base retains value.

Field team returned. Staff
retention: an expected return.

Head Office sent a letter. It
said 'thank you.' It meant it.

Not a debt, {player}. An
investment. Returns look strong.
